data.narrative:
Kraken Robotics is a public-stage defense and security company. The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI. The broader Defense & Security sector contains 26 same-sector peers, though narrower filtering constraints limit direct application.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The company occupies a narrow stage and valuation tier within Defense & Security; only 1 same-stage peer and 0 adjacent-stage or similar-tier peers met screening criteria, falling short of the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints required for robust median-based valuation. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material error given the heterogeneity of defense subsectors and business models.

Given these constraints, a triangulated valuation cannot be derived from the available dataset. Any range assignment would require supplementary data—including revenue multiples, EBITDA margins, or growth rates from the 2 public and 8 private comparables—or alternative methods such as DCF or precedent transaction analysis. The primary uncertainty is the absence of sufficient narrow-stage peer density to anchor a reliable comparable-company baseline. Further data collection on the identified public and top private peers is necessary before a defensible valuation synthesis can be offered.
